note: Gourdlight Eve (the autumn seasonal event): the city dressing kit (one GLB, a named mesh node per piece) and the wearable pumpkin head. The raw GLBs come from the deterministic Blender factory scripts/assets/gourdlight_eve/model.py, driven by export_gourdlight_eve.mjs, which runs this spec. Vertex-coloured, texture-free (no KTX2 step), original work with no reference image.
